title: LabFlow event envelope
description: CloudEvents 1.0 in structured JSON mode, with a stricter LabFlow profile: a closed attribute set, a UUIDv7 id, UTC time, and a required subject and W3C traceparent.

id.description: Event ID; consumers deduplicate on it.

type.description: labflow.<aggregate>.<event>.v<major>; an incompatible change gets a new major version.

subject.description: The order ID, so logs and dead-letter tooling can name the order without reading data.

time.description: When the change happened, in UTC.

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context of the change that produced the event (CloudEvents distributed tracing extension). All-zero IDs are invalid.
